# descope_saml_app (Resource)

Manages a single SAML federated application where Descope acts as the identity provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the SAML application.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that this application belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `acs_allowed_callback_urls` (Set of String) A list of allowed ACS callback URLS. This configuration is used when the default ACS URL value is unreachable. Supports wildcards.
- `attribute_mapping` (Attributes List) A list of attribute mappings from Descope user attributes to SAML assertion attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--attribute_mapping))
- `default_relay_state` (String) The default relay state. When using IdP-initiated authentication, this value may be used as a URL to a resource in the Service Provider.
- `default_signature_algorithm` (String) The signature algorithm used to sign SAML responses. Choose one of `""` (default, SHA-1) or `"sha256"` (SHA-256). Only applies to IdP-initiated flows — SP-initiated flows use the algorithm specified in the SP's SAML request.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Protects the application from being accidentally destroyed or replaced. Destroying or replacing a federated application breaks the service provider's configured integration, so these applications are protected by default. To allow the resource to be destroyed or replaced, for example in ephemeral test environments, set this attribute to `false` and apply the change first.
- `description` (String) A description for the SAML application.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the application should be enabled or disabled.
- `dynamic_configuration` (Attributes) Connection details are retrieved dynamically from the SP's metadata URL. Exactly one of `dynamic_configuration` and `manual_configuration` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dynamic_configuration))
- `error_redirect_url` (String) The URL to redirect to when an error occurs.
- `force_authentication` (Boolean) This configuration overrides the default behavior of the SSO application and forces the user to authenticate via the Descope flow, regardless of the SP's request.
- `id` (String) An optional identifier for the application. When omitted, an identifier is generated by the server. Can only be set when the application is created, and changing it will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `login_page_url` (String) The Flow Hosting URL. When left empty the project's default login page URL is used, and the computed value is reflected in this attribute. Read more about using this parameter with custom domain [here](https://docs.descope.com/sso-integrations/applications/saml-apps).
- `logo` (String) A logo for the SAML application. Should be a hosted image URL.
- `logout_redirect_url` (String) The URL to redirect to after logout. When the service provider sends the user to the `idp_logout_url`, Descope logs the user out and then redirects them to this URL.
- `manual_configuration` (Attributes) Connection details are provided manually. Exactly one of `dynamic_configuration` and `manual_configuration` must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--manual_configuration))
- `single_logout_enabled` (Boolean) Whether SAML Single Logout (SLO) is enabled for the application. When enabled, the service provider can log the user out by sending a signed `LogoutRequest` to the `idp_logout_url`, and Descope sends a `LogoutRequest` to the service provider when the user's Descope session ends.
- `single_logout_propagation` (String) What a logout started by the service provider reaches. Choose one of `""` (default, same as `"allApps"`), `"allApps"` to also log the user out of the other applications in the session, or `"none"` to only end the user's session without notifying any other application.
- `single_logout_scope` (String) Which Descope sessions a logout started by the service provider ends. Choose one of `""` (default, same as `"session"`), `"session"` to end only the session the logout request refers to, or `"allSessions"` to end every session of the user.
- `sp_single_logout_binding` (String) The SAML binding used for `sp_single_logout_url`. Choose one of `""`, `"redirect"`, `"post"` or `"soap"`. When `sp_single_logout_url` is set, an empty value means `"redirect"`, and when it's empty the binding is taken from the service provider's metadata. The `"soap"` binding sends the logout request directly from Descope to the service provider and requires an `https` URL.
- `sp_single_logout_url` (String) The service provider's Single Logout Service URL that logout requests are sent to. Required when `single_logout_enabled` is `true` and `manual_configuration` is used. With `dynamic_configuration` it can be left empty to take the URL from the service provider's metadata.
- `subject_name_id_format` (String) The subject name id format. Choose one of "", "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:unspecified", "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress", "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent", "urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:transient". Read more about this configuration [here](https://docs.descope.com/sso-integrations/applications/saml-apps).
- `subject_name_id_type` (String) The subject name id type. Choose one of "", "email", "phone". Read more about this configuration [here](https://docs.descope.com/sso-integrations/applications/saml-apps).

### Read-Only

- `idp_logout_url` (String) The logout URL of the application, to set as the sign-out URL in the service provider. This value is set by the server and is read-only.
